verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a customer-support SaaS platform like Pylon, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no retention policies, deletion workflows, or data purge controls. The SOC 2 / ISO 27001 certifications and the generic API data access are adjacent and do not show user-controlled retention or deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
